Calculation details

Material value = destruction stones + guardian stones + leapstones + Destiny Shards, at your chosen prices. Only the extra chest rewards count; normal clear rewards, auctions, events and first-clear rewards are excluded.

Extra value = (material value ÷ chest cost − 1) × 100. Market discount = (1 − chest cost ÷ material value) × 100. An 8,000-gold chest containing 12,000 gold of useful materials gives +50% extra value and a 33.3% market discount.

Honing materials are valued at their market replacement cost. Bound rewards are only useful on the character receiving them. A chest may still be worth buying for raid progression materials even when its honing value is below cost.

Ark Grid cores, accessories, ability stones, bracelets, card packs, fused leapstones and raid progression materials appear in the breakdown but carry zero gold value in the comparison. Their value depends on luck, character progress or future use.

In conversion mode, earlier T4 stones and leapstones are valued at one-fifth of the upper T4 unit price. This assumes rewards are pooled for exchange; incomplete groups of five remain until enough materials accumulate. Shards do not convert. The same material checkbox applies to direct and converted rewards.

Coverage: Act 4 / Armoche, Denouement / Final Day, Serca, Horizon Cathedral and Belgardin. Solo and Serca Matching entries are included where listed in the Western reward sheet. Belgardin Matching is excluded because the Western roadmap places it in a later update. Special Extreme and The First modes are outside this regular weekly chest comparison.

Sources & price baseline

Gate reward quantities and chest costs: Tylobic — Raids, Dungeons & Guardians Rewards, October 2026 / Arbiter of Death patch. Includes the separate extra-loot tab. Chest costs for Act 4 and Final Day checked against the Western September release notes.

Upper T4 baseline from ImDefild's package value guide: crystallized destruction stones 2,080 gold / 100, crystallized guardian stones 505 gold / 100, Great Destiny Leapstones 20 gold each, Destiny Shard Pouch (L) 205 gold / 3,000 shards. Earlier T4 baseline from the reward sheet's EUC market tab: destruction 399 gold / 100, guardian 76 gold / 100, Destiny Leapstones 10 gold each.

Reward quantities and chest costs checked against the October Western reward sheet on 25 October 2026. Earlier raids have different quantities in current KR calculators; Western and KR reward data are not combined here. Prices and rewards may change with later patches. No regional gold-price conversion is applied: enter your own market prices for NA or other regions.
